3,067 likes, 14 comments - madhurasrecipe on October 6, 2026: "पारंपरिक तांदळाची खीर | १० जणांसाठी रबडीसारखी दाटसर तांदुळाची खीर | Tandalachi Kheer Recipe

Ingredients
• 1/2 cup Rice
• 2 liter Milk
• 1/4 cup Cashew nuts
• 1/4 cup Almonds
• 1/4 cup Pistachios
• 7~8 Saffron strands
• 1/2 cup Sugar
• 1/4 cup Chironji
• 2~3 tbsp Fresh grated coconut
• 1/2 tsp Cardamom powder

Method
1. Wash 1/2 cup rice nicely with water 2 to 3 times and drain all the water completely.
2. Put the washed rice into a blender jar with a little water and grind it coarsely into a thick paste.
3. Take 2 liters of full cream milk in a big heavy vessel and put it on medium heat to boil.
4. Once the milk starts boiling, add the coarse rice paste into it and stir continuously so no lumps form.
5. Add 1/4 cup chopped cashews, 1/4 cup chopped almonds, and 1/4 cup chopped pistachios into the milk.
6. Cook the mixture on medium heat for about 15 minutes while stirring occasionally until the rice becomes soft.
7. Add 7~8 saffron strands into the pot and mix well.
8. Add 1/2 cup sugar, 1/4 cup chironji, and 2~3 tbsp fresh grated coconut into the pot.
9. Mix all ingredients nicely and cook on medium heat for another 10 to 15 minutes until the kheer turns rich and thick.
10. Add 1/2 tsp cardamom powder, mix well, and turn off the heat.
11. Serve warm or chill it in the refrigerator before serving.".
